summary: Tested GA4 analytics + admin dashboard end-to-end. All 14 backend pytest cases pass (auth is_admin flag, pageview anonymous+auth, admin 401/403 guards, overview/timeseries/top-pages/traffic-sources/recent-activity/users). Frontend: GA4 script loads, window.gtag is a function, POST /api/events/pageview fires on route changes, admin login shows nav-admin, /admin renders all stat & section testids, non-admin user has no nav-admin and is redirected from /admin to /dashboard.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first mount; charts still render correctly after layout settles. Consider setting explicit minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer to silence warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1000+ lines - consider splitting routers (auth, analysis, admin, analytics) into separate modules for maintainability.
admin_traffic_sources iterates every pageview in-memory; for scale, prefer a Mongo $group aggregation with $switch classification.
log_event(signup/login) is awaited inline in the auth endpoints; if events collection is slow it will delay auth responses. Consider fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task.
seed_data_creation: Pytest created one random test_<uuid>@sb.dev user via /auth/register to verify is_admin=false path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_analytics_admin.py and can be re-run with pytest. Admin dashboard testids verified: stat-total-users, stat-dau, section-timeline, section-top-pages, section-sources, section-users, section-activity, nav-admin.
